title: Enhancing light harvesting in bilayered dye-sensitized solar cells by tailoring light scattering with electrospun TiO2 nanofibers
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6171-6182
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08679A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Manikandan M., Anooja J., Narayanan Unni K. N., Suraj Soman, Sujatha Devi P.
Application of a scattering layer with anatase TiO2 fibers on a DSSC device enhanced the power conversion by 60% (8.67 ± 0.58%), primarily due to the combined effects of improved light harvesting through light scattering and enhanced dye anchoring.
